title: pandanus tectorius var. pedunculatus
intro: Pandanus tectorius var. pedunculatus, commonly known as the Tahina or Tahitian Pandanus, is a plant species that belongs to the Pandanus genus. It is a tropical plant with various medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Tahina Pandanus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing pain, inflammation, and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of the plant include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory actions, and it is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
